answer: A river research market pays agents to store sable and juniper survey data. Each paid slot commits a distinct encoded replica and must answer unpredictable block challenges before a short deadline. Rewards track proven storage slots, so extra aliases earn more only by supplying more storage or paying the compute cost of recreating replicas in time. This prices scarce resources instead of proving unique operators. Shared disks, fast re-encoding and corrupt auditors remain limits.
